title: Existence of a transcendence basis
statement: Let $F\to E$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. There exists a subset $B\subseteq E$ whose inclusion is a transcendence basis over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis].

proof.text: Apply Zorn to algebraically independent subsets. A union of a chain is independent since every polynomial uses finitely many variables. Maximality forces every element to be algebraic over the generated rational function field. Mathlib exists_isTranscendenceBasis gives this directly; scalar multiplication in a field extension is faithful.
